pages.title: Packed the Workbench
pages.text: Use a real working tool while away from base.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Install the upgrade, open its crafting panel and make something simple such as sticks. Take the finished result.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Open Crafting tab and take a recipe result using real inputs; it is a portable crafting grid, not access to unrelated storage.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Storage Crafting/Stonecutter tabs run their real recipes in the opened storage rather than a backpack.
